name: MND Association
summary: Supports people living with motor neurone disease in England, Wales and Northern Ireland with grants, information and emotional support, funds research and campaigns.

spending.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/294354/files/2024-12-31-accounts.md (Motor Neurone Disease Association, consolidated statement of financial activities 2024: charitable expenditure on care £11,263k, research £10,737k, campaigning £3,189k and volunteer development £1,159k = £26,348k, excluding £7,596k raising funds, of £33,944k total. Converted at the IRS 2024 yearly average of 0.783 pounds per dollar: https://www.irs.gov/individuals/international-taxpayers/yearly-average-currency-exchange-rates)

lines.label: Care and support for people with MND, and research
lines.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/294354/files/2024-12-31-accounts.md (care £11,263k plus research £10,737k = £22,000k, at 0.783 pounds per dollar; the model covers both)

lines.label: Campaigning and raising awareness, volunteer development
lines.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/294354/files/2024-12-31-accounts.md (campaigning £3,189k plus volunteer development £1,159k = £4,348k, at 0.783 pounds per dollar)
